correctness.rationale: For the 16-vertex Cayley graph on F_2^4 with five directions summing to zero, every nonzero difference has a unique representation with one or two directions, giving Aut(G)=F_2^4⋊S_5. Given one anchored selected vertex, its pointwise stabilizer is trivial iff all five direction-incidence columns are distinct. Exhaustively evaluating all 2^16 vertex subsets by this elementary criterion, and separately by explicit action of all 1920 automorphisms, yields precisely 560 minimal 4-sets and 192 minimal 5-cycles; the two independent complete methods classify all candidates including converse. BFS from every one of 560 optimal bases yields connected 5920-edge exchange graph, every eccentricity 4, degrees 20 or 28, and the two printed layer profiles. Independent reimplementation recovered the same exhaustive invariants. As the universe is fixed finite, exhaustive enumeration is a proof, not an extrapolation.

evidence: Boutin’s exchange results concern various specific graph families (not this highly symmetric non-outerplanar Cayley graph); generic base-size bounds cannot force an exact 560/192 orbit classification or graph diameter 4.
